name: POST AI — Preserve Original AI Conversations
description: When the user writes "POST AI:", the content immediately following it is an AI Conversation record that must be stored exactly as provided.
rules: Do NOT convert it into notes.
Do NOT extract only key points.
Do NOT replace the original conversation with a description.
The original pasted content is the actual record.

storesAs.title: Derived from the conversation, or provided by the user
storesAs.category: Selected based on where the user specifies it
storesAs.content: EXACT copy of the pasted conversation — metadata may be added alongside it, but must never modify or replace the original content

purpose: The AI Conversation Library exists so important architecture discussions, decisions, and build conversations are permanently preserved and can be referenced later without searching ChatGPT or Claude history.
